message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint with the City of Atlanta’s local authorities.  
Here’s how:

| Step | What to do | Contact |
|------|------------|---------|
| **1** | Identify the source of the noise (e.g., residential, commercial, construction) | – |
| **2** | Call the City of Atlanta’s non-emergency line at **(404) 656‑2000** (or dial **311** from within the city) to report the issue. | (404) 656‑2000 / 311 |
| **3** | If you prefer online, visit the City’s official portal: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/> → “Services” → “Noise Complaints.” | – |
| **4** | Provide details such as location, time, and nature of the disturbance. | – |
| **5** | Follow up if necessary; the city may send a citation or enforcement officer depending on severity. | – |

If the noise is from a business or construction site, you can also contact the **Atlanta Police Department** or the **Department of Public Safety** directly. For persistent or severe cases, consider filing a formal written complaint through the city’s website.
